segment.description: Hurricane Creek as cataloged spans two same-name TWRA-stocked creeks in West Tennessee: the Houston County creek (TWRA 'Hurricane Creek Trout Stocking Site' at 36.3365, -87.9035) draining west to Kentucky Lake/Tennessee River (HUC 06040005), and the Humphreys County same-name creek at Hurricane Mills (HUC 06040003). Both receive TWRA Seasonal rainbow stockings; temperature evidence below is from the Houston County creek only.
segment.boundaries: Houston County creek from its upper reach to the Kentucky Lake mouth (~36.35, -87.97), keyed to USGS 03606020 at the Houston/Stewart county line; Humphreys County creek at Hurricane Mills (USGS 03603500 area) carries its own 2026 stocking rows.

coldSource.notes: Identity: USGS 03606020 'HURRICANE CREEK NEAR STEWART, TN' verified via https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03606020,03606125,03605968&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb (Stewart County at the county line, HUC 06040005) - it is on the Houston County stocked creek, not the Humphreys County Hurricane Mills namesake (03603500), which was rejected as a same-name trap in the prior verified pass.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. Stocking is Seasonal only: Houston County rows for weeks of 2/22, 3/22, 3/29/2026 and Humphreys County rows for 2/22, 3/29/2026, all Rainbow Trout.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout population documented. Neither same-name creek appears anywhere on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout, special-regulation, or delayed-harvest entry; verified by string search of the live page) and no trout survey record was found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS summer grab samples 1984-1988 on the Houston County creek (03606020) ran 20-28 C with 26-28 C in July-August, and the only documented fishery is a 2-3-week Feb-Mar seasonal rainbow stocking.
